title: changed
description: What changed since a git ref, from describe changed --since <ref>: the resources whose file differs from the ref, for the board's history view, which dims the rest.

apiVersion.description: Always elderlygate/designer/app/v1: the form of e-designer's answers. An app's answers keep the family app (apiversion/v1/forms.yaml), apart from the files they describe.

kind.description: Always Changed, the kind of this answer, so a reader knows which schema its data meets.

ran.description: Where the answer came from; this contract fixes the app and the contract version, so an answer from anything else fails here.

app.description: Always designer, e-designer's product ID, since only e-designer gives this answer.

contract.description: Always v1, the contract version this schema belongs to.

data.description: Which resources differ from a git ref, or why that cannot be known. Not knowing is an answer, not an error, so a board that cannot tell shows every resource undimmed, never dimmed.

oneOf.description: Known: the resources whose text differs from the ref, uncommitted and untracked work included.

ref.description: The ref compared against, as asked.

ids.description: The ids of resources in the design now whose text differs from their text at the ref, or that the ref does not hold, sorted; a resource removed since the ref is not named. Empty when none differs.

oneOf.description: Not known, with why, so a reader knows what would answer it.

why.description: Why it cannot be known, an open word a program decides by (G-STACK-15). Known words: no_git: git is not on this machine; not_a_checkout: the design is not inside a git checkout, or git could not compare it; unknown_ref: the ref is not a commit this checkout knows; unreadable_at_ref: the design as it was at the ref cannot be read.

says.description: The same for people, never a machine path; programs never decide by it.
